ExternalLibraryWatchMode.description:
Whether a library is watched for real-time changes (watchfiles).

Real-time watching only works on local filesystems; on network mounts
(NFS/SMB/CIFS) the kernel does not deliver inotify events, so the library
falls back to its scheduled scan. ``AUTO`` decides from the detected
filesystem; ``EVENTS``/``OFF`` are explicit user overrides.

get.description: Streams the file blob for 'Open in slicer'. The token lives in the path and the original filename is the LAST path segment, so the URL ends in the file's extension. Slicers (OrcaSlicer, Bambu Studio, …) take the URL tail as the download name — if the extension isn't last (e.g. a ?token=… query trailing it) they save the blob but won't open it. The filename is cosmetic; access is governed solely by the token.
